I have reviewed the document provided, which is Assembly Bill 325 from California's 2025-2026 legislative session concerning the Cartwright Act and pricing algorithms.

Based on this document alone, I cannot provide comprehensive information about rental housing obligations and exemptions across the categories you've requested (rent caps, just cause eviction, deposits, application/screening fees, screening restrictions, and algorithmic pricing).

The document addresses only one narrow aspect related to your query:

citations.cited_text:
(a) It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of this chapter.
(b) It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services in the jurisdiction of this state.
